name: cerebellum and basal ganglia overview
title: Movement disorders with normal power: a cerebellar lesion lets movement start but makes it inaccurate, on the same side, with the subdivision deciding the signs; a basal ganglia imbalance either blocks starting (Parkinson disease, hypokinetic) or releases unwanted movement (chorea, hyperkinetic); each column gives the signs and the circuit that failed

root.title: Abnormal movement, power NORMAL: cerebellum or basal ganglia?
lines: both are SIDE LOOPS: cortex → loop → thalamus → cortex
no upper motor neurons of their own, so NOT an upper motor neuron disorder

groups.title: CEREBELLUM: movement starts, but is INACCURATE
lines: signs on the SAME side as the lesion

groups.title: BASAL GANGLIA: release vs suppress is off
lines: dopamine: direct pathway UP, indirect DOWN
